expected_findings.root_cause: The shape check before Editor.edit_files tests only for os.PathLike and no longer wraps a plain str, so a string filename is passed on as an iterable and consumed character by character when building the editor command.
expected_findings.failure_path: click.edit(filename="notes.txt") launches the editor with the nine single-character files n, o, t, e, s, ., t, x, t instead of notes.txt; saving creates stray files in the working directory and the intended file is never opened.
